predecessors.name: Empire of Brazil
predecessors.text: Pernambuco, whose independence Manuel Paes de Andrade 'announced' on 2 July 1824

successors.name: Empire of Brazil
successors.text: Pernambuco, retaken after the attack on Recife of 12 September 1824 and the defeat at Olinda five days later

ledger.x: 2 July 1824: Manuel Paes de Andrade proclaims the Confederation of the Equator at Recife.

wars.name: Confederation of the Equator
wars.outcome: Loyalist victory: Recife attacked on 12 September 1824, the rebels defeated at Olinda five days later; Frei Caneca executed 13 January 1825.

certainty.note: Only the province of Pernambuco is named; its limits are not described.
